notes:
What’s new in 0.1.32:
• A quieter Beebo: your computer does far less work when nobody’s watching. It no longer rewrites its settings file on every request, and it reads the poster index once instead of three times for every film.
• Skipping around in a film no longer leaves the file locked, so the converter can get to it.
• Tucked away in the tray, Beebo checks your library every two minutes instead of every 15 seconds, and not at all while it’s hidden.
• Away-from-home viewing checks in with Beebo’s servers far less often when the house is quiet, and your films never travel through anyone else’s servers.
• Storybooks: every narration you’ve already made is listed with its cast, so you can play it again instead of making it twice.
• Install Android 1.18 for that narration list, a working screen and How to play for every campsite game, and a phone that’s kinder to its battery.
